_doc: Every producer that may create a Linear ticket, with the job that consumes its tickets and the exit that closes them (ASK-4205).
Founder, 2026-11-09, verbatim: "What's the point of tickets that nothing can close?"
Read by q-system/.q-system/scripts/ticket_producers.py. Three readers of that module:
* linear-sync.py create refuses at run time a producer with no row, or whose row has no consumer or no exit, or whose row does not name linear-sync.py as a create path (gate: runtime).
* q-system/.q-system/tests/test_ticket_producers.py fails CI when a tracked file constructs an issue create and no row names it (gate: static). That is merge time, earlier than run time.
* the same test lints every row: a consumer, an exit of a known kind, a signature that compiles, and repo paths that exist.

id: stable name. signature: the regex that recognises its tickets, matched with re.M against the title, a newline, then the description; the same signatures as the 2026-11-09 inflow audit's classifier. null only with signature_note.
create_paths: where the issueCreate happens. A repo path, or an external ref with a prefix from external_prefixes.
gate: runtime | static | hook | none. none needs a gap ticket that builds the gate.
consumer: the script or agent that works or decides its tickets. exit: how they close, kind from exit_kinds, by = the script that does it.
board_state: optional id of a terminal-states.json ticket_states row the ticket enters at creation; that table owns its max age.

Not producers today: the stale-PR triage sweep (no inflow since 2026-10-20), linear-route-decide.py SPLIT (files nothing since ASK-4133), heartbeat.py (files GitHub issues; fleet-health-daily.py mirrors them, so they count under that row).

exit_kinds.worked: the fleet worker works it and it closes when its PR merges
exit_kinds.triage: a triage job decides it: promote to the worker, route, hold or close
exit_kinds.age-close: a close job closes it by age, reversibly
exit_kinds.recovered: its own check closes it when the condition clears
exit_kinds.keyed: one keyed ticket per subject, rewritten in place by its producer

external_prefixes.mcp:: a Claude session's Linear MCP tool; the local PreToolUse hook sees it, this repo's code does not
external_prefixes.chief:: a file in the chief repo (assafkip/chief); chief/linear.py does not read this registry
external_prefixes.cloud:: a claude.ai cloud routine using the Linear connector; no local hook or script runs there
